task: Add TTL support to the kvstore CLI: kv set <key> <value> --ttl <seconds> stores an expiry for the key. After the TTL has elapsed, get on that key must behave exactly like a missing key (error on stderr, exit 1) and the key must not appear in list output. Keys set without --ttl never expire. To keep expiry testable without waiting, the store must read the current time from the KV_NOW environment variable when it is set to an integer number of milliseconds since the Unix epoch, and from the system clock when it is not; use that same clock everywhere, both when recording an expiry and when deciding whether one has passed. You may change the store file format as needed. Add test coverage.
